project: Menucha Bikur Cholim of Lakewood (demonstration site)

references.signature: small photographs scatter across an ivory page like prints laid on a table, between solid blocks of deep green; each block fades and slides up into place as it scrolls into view, and every link dims when the pointer touches it
take: first screen: split hero, deep green left panel with a vertical uppercase nav list and an inset photograph, centered wordmark, ring-shaped inquire button, full-bleed photograph on the right, thin rule under a small notice line
logo strip on ivory under the hero
centered large serif statement with italic emphasis and an underlined italic link with arrow
scattered photograph cluster on ivory, staggered sizes and offsets, revealing as it enters
half-and-half blocks: photograph beside a deep green block holding a stacked serif list of links
quote block on olive ground with a large opening quotation mark beside a tall black-and-white photograph
closing 'We'd love to hear from you' on ivory with photographs at the edges, then a lavender footer with the mark centered

hover: 0.4s color and opacity transitions on links; ivory ground rgb(237,235,223); greens rgb(46,59,20) and rgb(63,82,26); sand rgb(214,201,181); olive rgb(173,159,55); lavender footer rgb(173,173,196)
narrow: nav collapses to a hamburger, wordmark centered, ring button at right; blocks stack full width

quality.desktop: split hero, statement, scattered prints, half blocks, quote, footer read as one calm sequence; nothing fights for attention
quality.mobile: collapses to hamburger + centered wordmark + ring; blocks stack; the cluster stays legible at 390px
quality.readability: Cardinal Fruit at 26-50px with Baskervville 14-18px body; dark green on ivory; no thin text on photos
quality.navigation: four-item vertical nav, ring inquire button, footer repeats the links; every link responded to hover
quality.reliability: loaded in one pass at both widths, three inner pages studied, no overlays
quality.suitability: a warm, dignified, photograph-led grammar for a care organization whose content is short and human; its floral subject is irrelevant

references.contributes: the dominant grammar: first screen, ground, type system, cluster, half blocks, quote, closing and footer
references.gaps_reviewed: no gaps recorded; hover probe covered the first screen only, which is where its controls are

references.signature: each cover slides up through a stage that stays pinned in the viewport, and the whole page ground changes color to match the cover that is passing

ground swap: the section's background color changes per card, 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1)
big year and issue number in the bottom corners of the pinned stage set in the display face; here the service name and its count position
underlined nav links, 20px, no button chrome

quality.desktop: one idea done perfectly: covers slide through a pinned stage while the ground repaints; nav is three underlined words
quality.mobile: the stage survives at 390px as a single pinned column
quality.readability: Practice at 20px nav and 56px corners; high contrast on every ground

quality.reliability: home and three inner pages at both widths, no overlays

references.contributes: the pinned stage whose ground changes color per card (the How we help section) and its corner typography
references.gaps_reviewed: no gaps recorded; the stage's swap is scroll-driven (driver: scroll), not autoplay, and the build copies it as scroll-driven

references.signature: the hero photograph holds still while the next section slides up over it, and layers inside each screen move at different speeds

parallax: photographs inside sections move at a different rate than the page
small uppercase tracked labels in the corners of the hero (place, time)
full-bleed photograph screens with a short caption in the bottom corner

quality.mobile: pinned title and swaps survive; heavy motion but legible
quality.readability: small extended sans at 10-12px uppercase is at the edge of legibility; not copied at that size
quality.navigation: sparse: select an apartment, book a call, contact
quality.reliability: loaded, but a consent panel covered part of every frame and only 'accept/decline' were offered; inner pages not studied

references.contributes: photographs moving at a different rate than the page in the cluster, the halves and the quote (behavior_from); its pinned hero was tried and not copied at its length

studied_not_selected.why: awwwards SOTD 2026-08-30; excellent, but saturated yellow and pink retail playfulness is the wrong register for a chesed organization
awwwards SOTD 2026-09-03; dark charcoal and pink collage for a comedian, wrong register; the tool found no inner pages behind its hamburger
typewolf SOTD 2025-12-14; warm, but its grammar is icon-card rows and stat cards, which the checker and the owner's feedback both forbid
typewolf SOTD 2025-09-26; corporate content site with cookie banner, card grids and an icon triplet; thin
typewolf SOTD 2025-09-28; dense dark editorial grid for an AI newsletter, wrong register
awwwards SOTD 2026-08-21; dark agency portfolio grid, wrong register
siteofsites 07/2026; pale pink ground with a giant script monogram, then an accordion list and forms carry the page; thin
